scope: Exactly the 50 requested erlang MFAs without direct pinned bif.tab declarations. The other 135 use C native adaptations or their explicitly catalogued C denial boundaries.

plans.reason: Retain complete pinned Erlang functions and required complete local helpers, following the existing protected-preloaded generator. Admit every exact internal dependency; never strip branches to evade imports. Underlying native local operations remain real C adaptations; remote-only internal endpoints receive reviewed denial bindings.

Pinned source bodies call themselves through erlang; these represent compiler/runtime intrinsics, not ordinary recursion to copy into a BEAM wrapper. Supply native instruction/export behavior and test direct/dynamic and compiled paths.

Upstream delegates to net_kernel/auth or whole-ERTS allocator services, which are not an Isolate runtime. Use explicit owned-state query adapters with provenance rather than booting those services or fabricating their module exports. In the unnamed no-distribution-service configuration disconnect_node returns ignored, not false, and get_cookie returns nocookie. Scoped memory requires real allocator instrumentation; no guessed zeroes. Document scope divergences from upstream service configuration.

The BEAM wrappers additionally autoload tracer modules before invoking native erts_internal tracing. Adapt the native local tracer implementation with native validation/error behavior for supported PID/local modes; explicitly deny module/NIF/host tracer modes before autoload. Do not import a booted code service into every protected preloaded module or return fake tracing success.

Whole-MFA host denial before effectful wrapper dependencies; no attempt to launch services, decompress/prepare code, open drivers or mutate distribution. This is the authorized capability boundary, not a replacement successful implementation.

Implement the explicitly authorized already-published no-op result and absent-module host denial in C. Running the original wrapper would prepare/finish new code and violate the exception. Validate atom/binary arguments, charge lookup/result work, and preserve code/exports/on_load state.
